newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah stronger despite ample supply.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah stronger despite ample supply.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah held on to its gains against the dollar despite a liquidity turnaround in slow late trading on Wednesday, dealers said.
They said overnight money fell to six percent from a morning high of 16.0 percent on ample supply, driving swap rates lower across the board.
But sentiment on the rupiah remained strong, keeping spot rates at around 2,427.80/28.15 at 0830 GMT against an opening of 2,428.0/29.0.
Tomorrow and today rupiah closed at 2,427.55/28.00 and 2,426.75/27.25, respectively.

One local bank dealer said operators continued to trade sideways on a lack of fresh leads. Another dealer said soem investors were taking a break after the election in Jakarta and turmoil in the Thai market.
"Sentiment on the rupiah remains firm. But there is no drive in the market," the local bank dealer said.
The local bank dealer said the stable rupiah in the past few days favoured going short on dollars in the near-term.
Dealers were mixed over the implication of the weakening dollar against the yen on the dollar-rupiah rates.

One U.S. bank dealer said some seemed to attribute the dollar-yen falls to the strengthening of the rupiah but others were looking at the fundamental impact on Indonesia's budget, which would be begative if the yen continues to rise.
Indonesia had set a dollar-yen exchange rate at 110 for its 1997/98 budget starting April.
The dollar slipped to its lowest level against the yen in almost seven months on Wednesday, sinking to 110.97 yen.
"The view from dollar-yen is mixed. But the fact is that the dollar-rupiah rate is more driven by liquidity today," the U.S. bank dealer said.
Overnight swap was at 0.4/0.6 and tom/next at 0.20/0.25.
One-month swaps softened to 11.5/12.5 from 12.25/13.25, two to 24.5/25.5 from 25.0/27.0, three to 38.0/39.0 from 39.0/40.0 and six to 77.0/78.5 from 77.5/79.0 points.
The central bank raised its intervention band by one point to 2,420/2,612 and its conversion band also by one point to 2,420/2,468 on Wednesday.
